# Aurum

> > Aurum is a specialized law firm providing expert legal counsel in Web3, blockchain, FinTech, and emerging technologies with a focus on regulatory compliance and cross-border structuring.

Aurum Law Firm serves DeFi, blockchain, and fintech clients with deep expertise in Web3 legal services, token classification, regulatory compliance, and AI/ML governance. The firm maintains offices in London and Dubai with a leadership team of recognized experts in blockchain, FinTech, and data protection law.

## Key Topics

- Web3 and Blockchain
- FinTech and DeFi
- Token Classification
- Regulatory Compliance
- GDPR and Data Protection
- CFTC Regulation
- Tokenization
- Cryptocurrency Law
- AI and Machine Learning
- Cross-Border Structuring
- DAO Governance
- Prediction Markets
- MiCA Compliance
- Stablecoins
- AI Agents
